title: 2027 Jeep Gladiator Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The market's only pickup with a removable top, the Jeep Gladiator, greets the 2027 model year with a new military-themed version with fitting graphics and colors.
body_markdown:
The Jeep Gladiator competes with midsize pickup trucks such as the Chevrolet Colorado, the Ford Ranger, the GMC Canyon, the Nissan Frontier, and the best-selling Toyota Tacoma. However, the Gladiator has features none of its competitors can match, including a removable top and doors, a folding windshield, and a solid-axle design that excels in rugged off-road scenarios.

## What’s New for the 2027 Jeep Gladiator


The Gladiator has been on the market since the 2020 model year, and the basic design has changed little. A refresh in 2024 brought subtle styling revisions up front and an upgraded interior with an improved infotainment screen. Since then, Jeep has been slowly rolling out a series of limited-edition models. We’ve already seen the Willys ‘41, Shadow Ops, 85th Anniversary Edition, Whitecap, Rockslide, and retro-fantastic Rewind. For 2027, Jeep launches the Gladiator Sarge with a military-inspired theme inside and out. The Sarge’s two-tone Drab Green and Cattle Tan interior is exclusive to the model, and its ‘41 Green exterior highlights make it stand out from the rest of the lineup.


## Design


The Jeep Gladiator is basically a four-door Wrangler with an extended wheelbase and a five-foot truck bed. It casts a unique profile, but the seven-slot grille is a classic Jeep feature. The fact that Gladiator owners can open their trucks to the elements with a removable roof and doors and a windshield that folds down mean Jeep’s pickup has unmatched visibility when driving on tight trails. The new-for-2027 Gladiator Sarge is offered with unique ‘41 Green-painted wheels, grille, and hardtop (white is also an option). A set of 33-inch BFGoodrich KO2 all-terrain tires comes standard, along with steel Rubicon rock rails with body-colored fender flares for protection from rocks and other off-road debris.


## Powertrain


The only engine offered in the 2027 Jeep Gladiator is a 3.6-liter V6 that produces 285 horsepower and 260 pound-feet of torque. An eight-speed automatic is the only transmission available since the six-speed manual was dropped a year ago, and four-wheel drive (4WD) is standard. Rumors of a V8 engine remain abundant, but Jeep has not committed to putting a Hemi in the Gladiator as it has in the Wrangler. Properly equipped, the 2027 Jeep Gladiator can tow up to 7,700 pounds, matching the best in the midsize truck class. The Gladiator’s payload maxes out at 1,720 pounds, but some models with a lot of options have lower ratings.


## Interior


Despite the Gladiator’s old-school looks, the interior is modern and full of up-to-date features and materials. Buyers who appreciate real buttons and dials will find what they’re looking for in the 2027 Gladiator, as its squared-off upright dashboard is full of them. Of course, there’s a touchscreen-based infotainment screen, as well. There’s a good amount of room for adults in the front and rear outboard seats. The rear seat can be folded upright, revealing a nice storage area below.


## Technology


A 12.3-inch touchscreen infotainment system sits in the center of the dashboard, and it runs Jeep’s well-sorted UConnect software. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are supported. In addition to on-road navigation, Jeep equips the Gladiator with integrated off-road trail guides that help owners find and plan off-road excursions on nearby trails. An off-road trailcam that points forward toward the ground is also available and helps drivers see obstacles ahead.

## Safety


Jeep doesn’t equip the entry-level Sport trim with any advanced driver-assistance features. An Active Safety Group is available on the Gladiator Sport S, 85th Anniversary, Willys, Sahara, Willys ‘41, Rubicon, Mojave, and Shadow Ops models that includes high-beam assist, blind-spot monitors and cross-path detection, and a rear park-assist system. Base Sport, Sport S, and Sahara models have basic cruise control, while higher-end models have adaptive cruise. While the 2027 Gladiator hasn't been rated by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS), the 2026 model received an Acceptable rating in the small overlap front crash test and the top Good ratings in the updated moderate overlap front test and updated side test. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) hasn’t given the Gladiator an overall rating, but it received four-out-of-five-star score in the frontal crash test and three stars in the rollover test.


## Pricing and Release Date


Jeep hadn't released pricing information for the 2027 Gladiator at the time of writing. For reference, the 2026 Gladiator Sport trim had a base MSRP of $41,815 (including destination). Prices went up from there, with the Mojave X and Rubicon X models costing more than $63,000, and we wouldn’t expect the 2027 Gladiator to be cheaper than the 2026 model. Jeep says the new-for-2027 Gladiator Sarge costs $500 more than a comparably equipped Willys or Rubicon model.
